title: A week with Perto at Grace Community
description: Demo conversations between Perto and fictional members of Grace Community Church, Toronto.
lede: Perto is Grace Community Church's pastoral companion on WhatsApp. To show how it talks, we invented fictional members from around Toronto and let each of them write for a week. What Perto replied is here, unedited.

facts: shifts that keep changing; whether the job will last
personas.story: Jun is 71 and still nursing. The shifts keep changing and he is not sure the job will last. He had not told anyone at church how rough it had been, afraid they would think he was not trusting enough.
personas.status: he decided to tell someone at Bible study that week, and did.

facts: British turns of phrase, a 🙏 at the end
a body still recovering; the dark coming early
personas.story: Kadeen teaches primary school and has been worn down by an illness that would not quite leave. She wrote on a Sunday night, tired, and came back two days later with a win: a fractions lesson that landed, and a daughter relieved to see her on the mend.
personas.status: she messaged her small group leader that week instead of waiting.

facts: short, 'brother', an emoji when it stings
a rough patch at home; gas prices eating the shifts
personas.story: Kwame drives for a living and the gas prices are eating his shifts. He wrote between runs, said he was fine, and then said the real thing: it has been rough with the family and he is just tired.
personas.status: he said he would text Marcus from church the next day.
